rows.quote: Summary-level data of genetic associations with IBD and its subtype were also obtained from the publicly available R8 data release of the FinnGen study.
rows.coder_note: The sentence states 'R8 data release of the FinnGen study'; no other passage gives a different release.

The attribution sentence cites reference 8 (Liu 2015, doi 10.1038/ng.3359, two dictionary rows), while the sentence describing the IIBDGC study (given under the other rows) reports 25,042 cases and 34,915 controls for IBD, the release-defining counts of another dictionary row (de Lange 2017) and of neither Liu 2015 row (rules E, H).

'A GWAS conducted by the Lee Lab' with reference 9 (Zhou 2020, doi 10.1038/s41588-020-0621-6), a DOI of no dictionary row; 'Lee Lab' fits two candidate rows (SAIGE PheWeb, TOPMed-imputed PheWeb) and the case and control counts separate neither.
